l-e-e6-b06-28.goal: Change “Today is Monday, the test is on Friday” into another form (expression, table, picture, words), and explain why meaning same.
l-e-e6-b06-28.material: Today na Monday. You wan say “The test is on Friday.” as “in a number of days.”
l-e-e6-b06-28.s.s1.prompt: Which sentence talk about same day?

l-e-e6-b06-28.s.s1.explain: From Monday, Tuesday na 1 day later, Wednesday na 2, Thursday na 3, and Friday na 4 days later.

l-e-e6-b06-29.title: Saying “the day before yesterday” with day of week
l-e-e6-b06-29.goal: Change “Today is Wednesday.” into another form (expression, table, picture, words), and explain why meaning same.
l-e-e6-b06-29.material: Today na Wednesday. You wan say which day of week “the day before yesterday” be, using day of week.
l-e-e6-b06-29.s.s1.prompt: Wetin day of week the day before yesterday be?
l-e-e6-b06-29.s.s1.r.c: Tuesday na yesterday. The day before yesterday na day before dat.

l-e-e6-b06-29.s.s2.model.1: E be two days before today, so Monday, two days before Wednesday, na same day.

l-e-e6-b01-31.s.s1.o.b: B: E good because because come later

l-e-e6-b01-31.s.s2.model.1: B go mean say rain fall because dem cancel game, so A correct.
